title: WebhookPayload
description: JSON schema for outbound webhook events dispatched to merchant endpoints by integration-service.

deliveryId.description: Unique identifier for this specific delivery attempt for logging, deduplication, and retry tracking.

eventId.description: Originating Kafka event identifier from the parcel lifecycle event.

eventType.description: Type of event triggering this webhook delivery.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the domain event occurred.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number per parcel (ADR 005) enabling merchants to detect and discard out-of-order events.

merchantId.description: Identifier of the merchant subscribing to this webhook.

parcel.description: Snapshot of parcel attributes at the time of the event transition.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the parcel.

fromStatus.description: Previous lifecycle status before this transition.

toStatus.description: Target lifecycle status of this transition.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the parcel was updated in the database.

reason.description: Failure reason or cancellation note, if applicable.
